profiling_method: Complete EOF Python csv.DictReader profile; independently checked all 20-column row widths, action/flag counts with AWK and complete source SHA256 with sha256sum. No source prices exported. Mechanical metadata checks do not replay the unbundled CSV.
limitations: This full HTTP response is a bounded sample, not every exchange session, all adjacent files, historical holidays, corrections or three dated priced gap cases. Its 153819 action-T rows all have the same UTC date, 2025-09-22, and end before 16:00 UTC. No calendar-based endpoint pair or price-gap outcome was established.

The first record is an Add action with snapshot and bad-receive-time flags. It is not an executed trade or a genuine first-trade receipt. Add/Modify/Cancel actions describe order-book events; a book Cancel is not a correction or bust of an executed trade.

Vendor receive timestamps are distinct from original Hoshi arrival. A populated ts_recv field and nine printed decimal digits do not prove clock quality, actual original delivery or nanosecond source precision. The separately checked pre-2017 Databento backfill uses SendingTime and F_BAD_TS_RECV, not original packet capture clocks.

No raw CSV, trade-price rows, prices or price-gap arithmetic are published, included in a runtime bundle or used for training. Public sample access, general vendor historical-pricing statements and an unsigned CME sample agreement do not establish project-specific use/display/redistribution permission.

No login, account, free-credit activation, contact form, external message, agreement, purchase, new resource or deployment occurred. Raw source remains private offline scratch research only. Original three priced-case, calendar/coverage/availability and rights requirements remain unresolved; no global free-data-unavailability claim.
